questions.question:
**Choose the word which is opposite in meaning to the word bold in the following sentence.**

He seems to have a__** propensity**__ to fight.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Aversion'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Propensity-** an inclination or natural tendency to behave in a particular way.(एक विशेष तरीके से व्यवहार करने के लिए एक झुकाव या प्राकृतिक प्रवृत्ति। एक विशेष तरीके से व्यवहार करने के लिए एक झुकाव या प्राकृतिक प्रवृत्ति)

 
 
• **For example-** He's well-known for his natural **propensity** for indiscretion.
 
 
 
• **Aversion- **a person or thing that arouses strong feelings of dislike.(एक व्यक्ति या वस्तु जो अरुचि की प्रबल भावना जगाती है)
 
 
• **For example-** I felt an instant **aversion** to his parents.
 
 
 
• As we can see, the meaning of **'Propensity'** is opposite to that of** 'Aversion'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is- **'Aversion'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Scepticism**- a sceptical attitude; doubt as to the truth of something.(एक संदेहवादी रवैया; किसी बात की सत्यता पर संदेह)
 
• **Penchant**- a strong or habitual liking for something or tendency to do something.(किसी चीज के लिए प्रबल या अभ्यस्त पसंद या कुछ करने की प्रवृत्ति)
 
• **Proclivity-** a tendency to choose or do something regularly(नियमित रूप से कुछ चुनने या करने की प्रवृत्ति)

questions.question:
Directions: Select a word or the group of words that is the most opposite in meaning to the underlined word in the given sentence.

The singer was __abetted__ by a skillful accompanist.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**constrain**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Abetted**" means to assist or help someone, typically in doing something wrong or illegal. ("उकसाना" का अर्थ किसी की सहायता या मदद करना है, आमतौर पर कुछ गलत या अवैध करने में।) 

 
 
• **Example**: *"The criminal was **abetted** by his accomplice in committing the robbery"*
 
 

**Let's see the meanings of the given words.**__

 
• **Assist** - to help or aid someone in achieving a task or goal. (किसी कार्य या लक्ष्य को प्राप्त करने में किसी की सहायता करना।)

 
 
• **Example**: *She **assisted** him with his homework.*
 
 
 
• **Support** - to provide assistance or encouragement to someone or something. (किसी को या किसी चीज़ को सहायता या प्रोत्साहन प्रदान करना।)
 
 
• **Example**: *He received **support** from his family during his recovery.*
 
 
 
• **Encourage** - to inspire confidence or enthusiasm in someone. (किसी में विश्वास या उत्साह जगाना।)
 
 
• **Example**:* She **encouraged** him to pursue his dream.*
 
 
 
• **Constrain** - to limit or restrict someone or something. (किसी को या किसी चीज़ को सीमित या प्रतिबंधित करना।)
 
 
• **Example**: *The budget **constraints** limited the scope of the project.*
 
 

**According to the meanings of the given words,** *the correct answer is** Option 4, i.e., constrain.***

• **Example**: *It was difficult to **discern **the truth from the lies in his story.*
 
 

**Let's see the meanings of the given words.**__

 
• **Perceive** - to become aware of through the senses, such as seeing, hearing, or touching. (इंद्रियों के माध्यम से जागरूक होना, जैसे देखना, सुनना या छूना।)

 
 
• **Example**: *She was able to **perceive** the faint scent of flowers in the air.*
 
 
 
• **Make out -** to understand or recognize something or someone with effort. (किसी चीज या व्यक्ति को प्रयास से समझना या पहचानना।)
 
 
• **Example**: *He couldn't **make out** the writing on the old document.*
 
 
 
• **Determine** - to come to a decision or conclusion about something. (किसी बात के बारे में निर्णय या निष्कर्ष पर पहुँचना।)
 
 
• **Example**: *She **determined** that she needed to start exercising more.*
 
 
 
• **Overlook** - to fail to notice or pay attention to something. (किसी चीज़ पर ध्यान न देना।)
 
 
• **Example**: *The teacher **overlooked** the student's mistake on the test.*
 
 

**According to the meanings of the given words, ***the correct answer is **Option 4, i.e., overlook.***

questions.question:
Directions: Select the word that is OPPOSITE in meaning to the word given in the sentence:

 He was eventually **__acquitted__** of the charges.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**convict**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Acquitted** refers to the state or quality of being declared not guilty of a crime or offense by a court of law. (बरी किए जाने का मतलब कानून की अदालत द्वारा किसी अपराध के लिए दोषी नहीं घोषित किए जाने की स्थिति से है।) 

 
 
• ***Example**: Being **acquitted** of a criminal charge, which means being found not guilty by a jury or a judge.*
 
 

**Let's see the meanings of the given words**__

__
 
• **Inform** refers to the act of providing someone with information, knowledge, or details about something. It implies a level of communication or disclosure, and suggests that someone is being made aware of something. (सूचना किसी को किसी चीज़ के बारे में जानकारी, ज्ञान या विवरण प्रदान करने के कार्य को संदर्भित करती है। इसका तात्पर्य संचार या प्रकटीकरण के स्तर से है, और यह सुझाव देता है कि किसी को किसी चीज़ के बारे में जागरूक किया जा रहा है।)

 
 
• ***Example**: **Informing** someone of a job opportunity, which means letting them know about a new job opening or career opportunity*.
 
 
 
• **Release** refers to the act of setting something free, letting it go, or making it available to others. (रिलीज़ का तात्पर्य किसी चीज़ को मुक्त करने, उसे जाने देने या दूसरों को उपलब्ध कराने के कार्य से है।)
 
 
• ***Example**: **Releasing** a product, which means making it available for purchase or use by the public.*
 
 
 
• **Abuse** refers to the act of treating someone or something with cruelty, violence, or harm. (दुर्व्यवहार किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु के साथ क्रूरता, हिंसा या हानि के व्यवहार को संदर्भित करता है।)
 
 
• ***Example**: Emotional **abuse**, which refers to the act of using words, actions, or other means to cause mental or emotional harm or distress.*
 
 
 
• **Convict** refers to the act of finding someone guilty of a crime or offense by a court of law. It implies a level of legal responsibility or liability for the crime or offense in question, and suggests that someone has been found to have committed a criminal act and is subject to punishment or penalty. (अपराधी कानून की अदालत द्वारा किसी अपराध या अपराध के दोषी को खोजने के कार्य को संदर्भित करता है। यह प्रश्न में अपराध या अपराध के लिए कानूनी जिम्मेदारी या दायित्व के स्तर को दर्शाता है, और यह सुझाव देता है कि किसी व्यक्ति को एक आपराधिक कार्य करने के लिए पाया गया है और वह सजा या दंड के अधीन है।)
 
 
• ***Example**: Being **convicted** of a criminal charge, which means being found guilty by a jury or a judge.*
 
 

**According to the meanings of the given words,** *the correct answer is **Option 4, i.e., convict.***

questions.question:
**Directions: **In these questions, choose the word opposite in meaning to the word given in the bold.

**Analogue**
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**Difference**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Analogue** is a term used to describe something that is similar to something else, but not necessarily the same. It could mean something that is related, or it could mean something that looks similar, but is actually different. 

 
 
• **For example,** *a digital watch is an **analogue** of a traditional watch, meaning it looks similar, but the technology is different. *
 
 

**Let's see the meanings of the given words.**__

 
• **Correlate** is a verb meaning to establish a relationship or connection between two items, usually cause and effect. 

 
 
• **For example, ***scientists often **correlate** higher levels of carbon monoxide in the atmosphere with higher levels of global warming*.
 
 
 
• **Cognate** is an adjective used to describe something that is related or connected, usually through a common ancestor. 
 
 
• **For example,*** the English word “father” is **cognate** with the Spanish word “padre”.*
 
 
 
• **Dialogue** is a noun meaning a conversation between two or more people. 
 
 
• **For example,*** two people having a **dialogue** about the effects of global warming would be discussing the topic back and forth.*
 
 
 
• **Difference** is a noun meaning the quality or state of being different from something else. 
 
 
• **For example,** *there is a **difference** between a tiger and a lion, even though they belong to the same family.*
 
 

**According to the meanings of the given words, ***the correct answer is** Option 4, i.e., Difference.***
